name: Hello Watch 3 Plus
subtitle: 2.04-inch AMOLED Bluetooth calling smartwatch
description: Hello Watch 3 Plus Gen 2 is a smartwatch with a 2.04-inch AMOLED display, 60Hz refresh rate, Bluetooth calling, 1GB ROM, health tracking, sports modes, magnetic charging, and IP68 water resistance for everyday wear.
story: Designed for daily wear, Hello Watch 3 Plus Gen 2 combines a large square display with calling and activity features in one wrist device. Pair it with a compatible Android or iOS phone to manage calls, notifications, settings, and health data through supported connectivity and companion-app functions. The interchangeable metal-style and silicone straps offer two wearing options. Battery life is rated at up to around three days, with actual results depending on brightness, notifications, calling, and other usage.

specs.battery_life: Up to around 3 days of typical use
specs.app_support: Companion app for health data and settings

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
